# Reuse what the codebase already has before adding a dependency or helper

Before adding a dependency, helper or global, check for an existing one — e.g. `parseAst` from Vite instead of `acorn`, `std-env`'s `isAgent`, the existing `__vitest_browser_runner__` global.

**Why:** Requested on 3 PRs by 2 reviewers.

## Examples from PR review history

- > Curious why `acorn` instead of `import { parseAst } from "vite";` that is available for free?
  — @AriPerkkio on PR #9210: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9210#discussion_r2664345473
- > `std-env` provides `isAgent`, we can just use that (the package is already used for isCI check) -
  — @sheremet-va on PR #9779: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/9779#discussion_r2882800627
- > If anything needs to be available globally, we already have `__vitest_browser_runner__`
  — @sheremet-va on PR #10102: https://github.com/vitest-dev/vitest/pull/10102#discussion_r3077760876
